name: KDP Coffee Roasting / K-Cup Plant - Sumner WA

fieldNotes.location: Positively confirmed by Street View: the building front on 142nd Ave E carries the 'Keurig Dr Pepper' logo and name, with building number '3418' (roster gave 3424; some listings 3324 - the on-site marked number is 3418 142nd Ave E, Sumner WA 98390). Roster coords were ~140 m south of the building front; locked center at 47.2253/-122.2425.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck gate. The building's truck yard and the large trailer/container drop yards open directly onto 142nd Ave E via wide unbarred driveways. Street View north of the building shows the tractor yard fully open to the road - no barrier arm, no booth.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at any driveway. Open multi-tenant industrial park access.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate, so no remote check-in inferred.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band. This is a large cross-dock warehouse with long dock-door rows on both the north and south building faces; estimate ~64 doors total. Exact count approximate - flagged.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ band. Extensive trailer/container drop yards north of the building and along the south - many dozens of parked trailers and intermodal containers in organized rows.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock layout - dock banks on physically separate north and south building faces, consistent with separated shipping vs receiving flow.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Multiple separate driveway access points off 142nd Ave E serve the north and south yards - inbound and outbound use different points.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide unbarred yard aprons and multiple lanes of paved width off 142nd Ave E - ample room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Site is inside the dense Sumner/Puyallup Valley distribution district - wall-to-wall large warehouses and intermodal yards. Urban.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep internal cross-drives and large yard aprons easily stack 3+ trucks before the docks.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters this building parcel (rail lines exist elsewhere in the valley but not into this site).
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~110 trailers/containers estimated across the captured imagery; the drop yards are partly shared multi-tenant so the figure is approximate - flagged.

citations.claim: Active Keurig Dr Pepper Sumner WA reqs (Forklift Operator, Maintenance Supervisor, Electro-Mechanical Technician) - live manufacturing operation.
Coffee roasting plant in Sumner (Green Mountain/Keurig lineage).

verification.rationale: KDP coffee roasting/K-Cup plant on 142nd Ave E Sumner currently operating (active careers reqs + Street-View KDP logo); no closure/sale found. FLAG: confirm exact street number (3418 vs 3324/3424 same campus); KDP coffee-business spinoff is a forward risk, not current.
